author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಇತಿಹಾಸ ಸೇರುವುದು ಕ್ಷಣವೊಂದು ಉರುಳಿದರೆ 
ಮತಿಗೆಡದೆ ಸದ್ಯವಿಹ ಚಣಚಣವ ಬದುಕು
ಅತಿಮೋಹವಿಲ್ಲದಿರೆ ಭವಿತವ್ಯ ಸುಂದರವು
ಋತನಡೆಯ ಗುರಿಯಿರಲಿ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: A moment joins history once it rolls by;
without losing your head, live each present moment;
without excessive attachment, the future is beautiful;
let walking in ṛta be your goal, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Every moment soon becomes the past. Live the present fully, without clinging, and the future takes care of itself. Aim to live in harmony with ṛta, the cosmic order.
